_meta.agentReadableSummary: Audit an x402 payment-required envelope and return normalized payment requirements, USDC prices, cheapest compatible Base-USDC quote, spend decision, and warnings before paying.

description: Normalize and audit an x402 402-payment envelope before an agent spends. Accepts a raw response body, a JSON envelope, or x402 payment headers and returns requirement count, networks, schemes, payTo recipients, USDC price bounds, the cheapest compatible Base-USDC requirement, a deterministic allow/review/deny decision, facilitator hints, and fail-closed warnings for malformed or non-Base quotes. $0.01/call.

envelope.description: Raw x402 response body or JSON object containing accepts/paymentRequirements/requirements.

expectedAsset.description: Expected USDC asset address on Base.

expectedNetwork.description: Expected payment network. Defaults to Base mainnet CAIP-2.

headers.description: Optional response headers. Header values may include payment-required JSON or base64 encoded JSON.

maxUsdc.description: Optional caller budget in USDC. Emits a warning when the cheapest requirement exceeds it.

name: x402-envelope-auditor
title: x402 Envelope Auditor
